title: 2× exception raised without `from` in except block (W0707, first at line 413)
detail: At 2 location(s) (first at line 413), a new exception is raised inside an `except` block without `raise ... from original_exc`. This discards the original traceback and makes debugging harder. Fix: `raise NewExc(...) from exc` to preserve the chain.

title: Line 46: inconsistent return statements — some paths return a value, some don't
detail: The function at/near line 46 has paths that return a value and paths that fall off the end (implicit `return None`). Callers expecting a return value silently receive `None` on the implicit path. Fix: add explicit `return None` or ensure all paths return a consistent type.

title: Builtin `id` shadowed by local variable (W0622)
detail: Local variable(s) at lines 142, 163, 231, 343, 429 shadow the builtin(s) id. If the builtin is needed elsewhere in the same scope, the shadowing causes a confusing `TypeError` or silent misbehavior. Fix: rename the local variable to avoid shadowing.
